title: Rim light on a turntable
label: Dimetric photo studio: a pill on a graduated turntable, a key spotlight with barn doors at the back left, a fill spotlight at the front right, a paper backdrop and a dimmer wired to both. The rim is strongest on the edge facing the key.
caption: An edge is as bright as it faces a lamp: the rim turned to the key is drawn full, the edge facing the half-dimmed fill is a thin line, and the two points where the edge runs along the light keep only a trace. Move the pointer across the figure to turn the table: the pill, its pad and the pointer turn, the dark arc and both dotted rays stay on the edges facing their lamps, and the lamps never move.
